checklist.detail: Choose your country and click Apply. The Windows VMs, including A-GUI, restart about a minute later.

checklist.text: Wait for the VMs to restart (3 to 5 minutes)
checklist.detail: Log back in to A-GUI when its login screen returns. The Gaia VMs restart too.

checklist.text: Open Lab Start again and click Check status
checklist.detail: Use the Lab Start shortcut on the desktop. The Localise tab should say Done.

checklist.text: Note the logins and IP addresses (tab 3)
checklist.detail: Double-click any value to copy it. The full list is on page 3 of each lab guide.

checklist.text: Look through the Check Point Tools folder (tab 4)
checklist.detail: It holds the tools the labs use.
Corrections and tips for steps that catch people out.

credentials.notes: Jump host. Settings are applied from here.

tools.*SmartConsole*: Check Point SmartConsole - the management GUI used in most labs.
tools.*MobaXterm*: SSH client for connecting to the Gaia command line.
tools.*PuTTY*: SSH client for connecting to the Gaia command line.
tools.*WinSCP*: Copies files to and from the Gaia VMs over SSH.

notes: Ignore any lab steps that use Hyper-V Manager.
Use the RDP-HOST connection rather than the console view for a better screen, clipboard and keyboard.
